source_metadata.source_title: Postmarketing Safety Surveillance of Beta-2 Adrenergic Receptor Agonists
source_metadata.translated_title: β2-肾上腺素能受体激动剂上市后安全性监测

bilingual_segments.source_en: In a cohort of 15,000 patients exposed to a 5 mg daily dose, adverse drug reaction (ADR) events involving the β2-adrenergic receptor (β2-AR) did not increase significantly (p = 0.24; Fig. 1A) [1].
bilingual_segments.target_zh: 在每日接受 5 mg 剂量的 1.5万 名患者队列中，涉及 β2-肾上腺素能受体 (β2-adrenergic receptor, β2-AR) 的药物不良反应 (adverse drug reaction, ADR) 事件未显著增加（p = 0.24；图1A）[1]。
bilingual_segments.translation_basis: 15,000 -> 1.5万 magnitude preserved; 5 mg unit, negation (未显著), Fig. 1A, and [1] intact; first-mention English anchors kept.

bilingual_segments.source_en: While these preliminary findings may suggest acceptable tolerability at 25 °C storage, results are limited to short-term follow-up and require further validation.
bilingual_segments.target_zh: 尽管上述初步发现可能提示该药在 25 °C 储存条件下耐受性可接受，但结果仅限于短期随访，仍需进一步验证。
bilingual_segments.translation_basis: Explicitly restored concession connector (尽管…但…); preserved modal hedge (may suggest -> 可能提示) and hard limiter (limited to -> 仅限于).
